carryInDispositions.result: Mint and renewal use the frozen adapter code map: OPERATOR_DENIED, LOCAL_SEAT_DENIED, LOCAL_SEAT_THROTTLED with Retry-After and a generic failure message, one request per explicit submit, no server text reflected, no secret in state, storage or URLs.

A renewal that returns a different playerId is refused (bearer, binding and transport untouched) and the panel directs the operator to forget the sign-in and reclaim with the new password; the in-repo sequence re-provision -> new playerId -> refused while the ghost holds a seat -> GM RemoveParticipant -> admitted, ghost row revoked not deleted.
Create, join and renewal password inputs are uncontrolled unnamed type=password refs with autocomplete current-password. Packaged password-manager proof stays in LSC-2P.
The mounted LocalSeatOperatorPanel refreshes seats after an unknown-outcome write before any second write; LocalSeatOperatorPanel.tsx is unchanged.
TAKEN. The create-host path calls mintCoopCredential("primary", password); the panel-local mintToken, ITokenState and VaultIdentityError are deleted.
carryInDispositions.duplicateDisposition: KEPT under hard invariant 11 and named in the commit message and PR body; outside every LSC-2 leaf; open Root registration follow-up CF-LSC2-L1-DUP.

carryInDispositions.result: ACCEPTED. The panel adds no clock check; a primary token issued 30 s ahead is accepted and the same token through a seat is refused INVALID_TOKEN with no stored bearer; expiry, lifetime, agreement and displayName checks refuse for both.
OPERATOR_DENIED shows the wrong-password message with the generic kind; OPERATOR_IDENTITY_REQUIRED drives the vault-settings link for create and join.
NOT TAKEN. No edit to securitySchemas.ts, token.ts or server auth.ts; the open Root registration follow-up is unchanged.
CLOSED, NOT TAKEN by Root ruling (owner-ruling 3c074559a: I2 informational). LocalSeatOperatorPanel.tsx is unchanged.

The disclosure states that revocation or re-provisioning stops the next mint or renewal while old bearers live to their original expiry (local seats at most one hour) and makes no immediate-eviction claim.
V2.2.0-STEPS.md is file-counted; LSC-2 adds it to its ownershipExceptions at closure, as LSC-2C and LSC-2O did.
CampaignNavigation.test.tsx is not edited and passes unchanged (10/10 in the guards); navigation mounting is tested from LocalSeatCredentialPanel.test.tsx LS22.
LS21a/b/c are hosted in LocalSeatCredentialPanel.test.tsx with no unregistered leaf.
Settled by the pre-RED scratch probe (PASS): RemoveParticipant host path and transport reconnect run in jsdom.

No ordinary-UI GM ghost-removal control exists and LSC-2 adds none: LS21c removes the ghost through the transport sendHostIntent RemoveParticipant path. LSC-2P must record the "ghost retained until ordinary removal" journey step as absent or register a UI leaf.

greenDecisionsDifferingFromSizingDraft: LS08: a second join for a match that already has a stored bearer of a different playerId is refused with the IDENTITY_CHANGED message before the bearer or binding is replaced. This guard is not in the sizing draft (about 8 counted lines in CampaignCoopEntryPanel.tsx).

LS13: the pin "a bad stored value falls back to primary" is realized as: an invalid stored choice is never used (the chooser is disabled with the frozen INVALID_CHOICE message, nothing mints) and "Forget next-join choice" returns the choice to primary. The frozen store throws INVALID_CHOICE by design, and the join reads the choice through the same store, so a silent display-only fallback would disagree with what a join does. Flagged for Root.
LS16: with no stored binding CoopCredentialRenewal renders nothing (the sizing draft showed a "joined credential unavailable" problem); other storage errors still show a sanitized message.

LS17/LS19: CoopCredentialRenewal takes optional reloadPage and navigatePage props (defaults window.location.reload and window.location.assign) because jsdom cannot observe location changes; CampaignNavigation passes neither.
